title: The question the core asks before a helper starts, and the answer
description: An active add-on with `before_start = true` gets `request` on stdin of `orch <name> before-start --json` and prints one `answer`. Any add-on can offer it; the core names none (contracts/addon-manifest.md, Before a helper starts).

ext.description: ext.<name> of the ACTIVE add-ons only.

agent.description: The helper tool this start would use.

agents.description: Helper tools found on this machine.

model.description: The ticket's model as it is now (null: not picked yet).

model_up.description: orch or the helper moved this ticket up to the big model (it may use it now).

providers.description: Whose sign-in each helper tool of `agents` runs on, when the tool says (e.g. a subscription of this provider).

agent.description: A tool was given for this start: an answer cannot change it.

model.description: A person set the model: an answer cannot change it.

credit.description: Only on a start on an API key: the credit it runs on. The answer may only refuse it (go false); its agent, model and account are not used and the ticket is not held.

account.description: The credit's LABEL. Never a key or its name.

agent.description: Use this helper tool (only when one of `agents` and not chosen).

model.description: Use this model (only when a person did not set one).

account.description: The account LABEL the start uses. Never a key or login.

say.description: One plain line shown with the start.

why.description: Plain words the ticket shows while it waits.

until.description: When it can start again; the ticket then waits for that time.
